title: Homesite Reservation Expiry and Reinstatement Schedule
content:
Schedule of the terms that apply to an expired Homesite Reservation hold, by premium class.

| Premium class | Reinstatement window (calendar days after the expiry date) | Reinstatement fee (USD) | Maximum reinstatements per reservation | Funds on an expired hold refunded automatically once the reinstatement window closes | Premium holding fee retained by Calloway when a hold expires |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Interior Homesite | 3 | 100.00 | 1 | Yes | No |
| Corner Homesite | 3 | 100.00 | 1 | Yes | No |
| Cul-de-Sac Homesite | 2 | 250.00 | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Greenbelt Homesite | 2 | 500.00 | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Water-View Homesite | 1 | 750.00 | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| Golf-Frontage Homesite | 1 | 1000.00 | 0 | Yes | Yes |

## Notes

- The reinstatement window is the number of calendar days after the expiry date within which an expired hold may be reinstated.
- The reinstatement fee is the class fee to reinstate an expired hold.
- A maximum of 0 reinstatements (Water-View Homesite and Golf-Frontage Homesite) means an expired hold of that class has no reinstatement available.
